newsitem.title: USA: Premier to buy latex gloves from Safeskin.
newsitem.headline: Premier to buy latex gloves from Safeskin.

text.p: Premier Inc, an alliance of hospital and health systems, said Thursday it reached a dual-source agreement for latex exam gloves with Safeskin Corp and Ansell Perry Inc.

Part of Premier's purchasing commitment program, the five-year agreements feature savings for Premier hospitals and systems which agree to buy 90 percent of the products covered from one of these suppliers.
Pricing is effective February 1, 1997. Other details were not disclosed.
